# secureaccess_service_object (Resource)

This resource manages a Service Object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_service_object" "example" {
  name        = "my_service_object"
  description = "This is my service object."
  protocol    = "tcp"
  ports       = ["8080"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Service Object.
- `ports` (List of String) List of ports or port ranges of the Service Object.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol of the Service Object.
  - Choices: `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `any`

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the Service Object.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_service_object.example "<id>"
```
